title: A screen reader user cannot speak to the coach: the mic only works while held
what: The coach chat mic records only while a finger stays on it and stops the moment it lifts. With a screen reader on, a double-tap presses and lets go at once, so nothing is heard. There is no tap-to-start, tap-to-stop way. The coach chat is hidden today.
expected: The mic can also be started and stopped with single taps, or offers a screen reader action, so people using a screen reader can talk to the coach.
how_often: every time, once the coach chat is switched on
fix_line: Let a tap start and a second tap stop the recording.

title: In the coach chat a screen reader cannot tell who said what, and new replies are not read out
what: The member's messages sit on the right in orange and the coach's on the left in grey, with no spoken 'You' or 'Coach'. A new reply or the typing dots are not announced, so a screen reader user does not know the answer has come. The coach chat is hidden today.
expected: Each message is read with who sent it, and a new coach reply is announced.
how_often: every message, once the coach chat is switched on
fix_line: Add who sent it to each message and announce new replies.

title: In an exercise's history, the best set is marked only by colour, and drop and failure sets only by a letter
what: On the History tab of an exercise, the best set of each workout is shown only with an orange wash and bold orange text. Drop sets and sets to failure show just 'D' or 'F'. A screen reader says nothing about the best set and reads the bare letter, and a colour-blind member may miss the highlight.
expected: The best set also says it in words (for example 'best set'), and D and F are read as 'drop set' and 'to failure'.
fix_line: Add spoken words for the best set and the D and F marks.

title: Each record row on the Charts page opens the exercise but shows no arrow
what: In the records list on the Charts page, every row opens that exercise when tapped, but it has no arrow or other sign. The 'See all records' line and the other lists on the same page do show an arrow, so these rows look like plain text.
expected: Record rows show the same small arrow as the other rows that open something.
fix_line: Add the arrow to each record row.

title: A screen reader is not told when a Balance check choice fails to save
what: When 'Keep it', 'Go back' or 'Not now' on the Balance check card fails, a red line appears in the card, but it is not announced. A screen reader user hears nothing and may think it worked.
expected: The failure line is announced when it appears.
fix_line: Make the failure line announce itself.

title: No automatic accessibility check ever runs on the phone app
what: The automatic accessibility check in the build looks only at the gym admin app. The phone app's screens are never checked by a tool, so missing spoken names and small tap areas are found only by reading the code.
expected: An automatic check of spoken names and tap sizes runs over the phone app's screens in the build.
fix_line: Add an accessibility check to the phone app's cloud tests.
